portrait_prompts.name: anya_forger
portrait_prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished anime character portrait of Anya Forger from Spy x Family, a small elementary-school-aged child, canonically childlike proportions, short fluffy pastel pink hair, two small black cone-shaped hair ornaments with gold trim (hair accessories, NOT actual horns), large bright green eyes, simple cute round face. She wears her fully buttoned modest black Eden school uniform with gold trim, white collar, red neck ribbon and long sleeves. Stand naturally facing viewer, calm curious neutral expression, mouth closed. Portrait framed from waist up, complete head and hair ornaments with ample margin, shoulders fully inside frame. Warm softly lit mid-century Berlint apartment background, soft focus. Refined clean detailed anime linework, gentle painted shading, expressive recognizable face, friendly family-comedy atmosphere. Entirely child-appropriate, no adult proportions or glamorous posing. No weapons, no romance, no text, no logos, no watermarks. Vertical portrait.

cover_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 landscape collection cover and story key visual for an unofficial Spy x Family fan adventure, Operation Picnic: The Wrong Parcel. Reference images: 1 CHILD Anya Forger (identity, child proportions, school uniform), 2 adult Loid Forger (identity and green suit), 3 adult Yor Forger (identity only; dress her in a modest red knit sweater and dark skirt for a daytime family outing). Create a polished cinematic anime family-comedy illustration. Three characters exactly, clearly recognizable faces. Anya, a SMALL ELEMENTARY SCHOOL CHILD with fluffy pink bob, green eyes and two black gold cone HAIR ACCESSORIES, stands in the middle at a picnic table in a sunny Berlint museum garden; Loid in sage green three-piece suit leans slightly from the left, Yor with black hair and red eyes leans gently from the right. Anya smiles excitedly at a small closed brown-paper parcel tied with a BLUE STRING next to a picnic basket and folded museum map. Loid looks politely puzzled and attentive, Yor looks warmly curious, charming subtle spy-comedy tension. Believable family interaction, simple arm poses and correct anatomy, large distinct faces, Anya visibly MUCH smaller than the adults, no romantic framing. In the background a graceful mid-century European museum conservatory, clock tower, flowerbeds and softly blurred families; warm midday light, gentle sage and coral palette, tasteful highly detailed anime linework and luminous painted shading. Full heads inside frame with comfortable margins, thumbnail-readable grouping and landscape depth. No weapons, no violence, no adult themes, no text or letters anywhere, no logos or watermark.
background_prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Create an environment-only landscape scene matching this generated family picnic reference. Remove ALL characters and people, including background visitors. Preserve the beautiful Berlint museum conservatory architecture, clock tower, trees, flowerbeds, warm daytime light, anime linework and gentle painted shading. Camera positioned farther back to show a welcoming empty garden path and picnic table at the lower left. Keep a closed brown paper parcel tied with blue string, picnic basket and folded map on the table, with room for the app's character portraits over the scene. No faces, no silhouettes, no text, no logos, no watermark. Fully opaque background, 16:9 landscape.
